end.summary:
Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Counted cube faces and cylinder flat faces.
Aditya first gave incorrect cube-face counts, then corrected to six faces.
Described a cylinder as having two flat faces and one curved face.
Teach-back was not passed; 2 of 3 attempts were unaided correct.
end.parentNote: Asha practised shape names through toy and object examples, then used face-counting and flat/curved-surface clues. Aditya described a cylinder using its two flat faces and one curved face. There was a mix-up about the number of cube faces; it was corrected later to six (correctAfterLastSeen: true). At home, ask them to find one cube, cylinder, sphere, cone, or cuboid and name one feature.
